The "'''Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings'''" were one of the many notable exploits that the criminal organization "[[Red & Black League]]" that, led by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]], had carried out by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="HR" /> The event shared its name with the [[Ursellin system/Legends|Ursellin system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and was connected to the sport of [[Sun jammer racing|racing]] [[sun jammer]]s, a type of large, [[Star/Legends|solar]] wind&ndash;driven [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings" were mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
